analyst_view.overall: Le Mans (13th, 11 pts) host Lille (3rd, 21 pts) on Saturday evening. Davide Ancelotti's Lille lost 1-0 at home to Lyon last time and play Bayern Munich in the Champions League tonight (Wednesday), three days before this game, so rotation is likely. Lille are without Tiago Santos (out for the season), Hamza Igamane (knee) and Tanguy Nianzou (muscle, out for weeks), which the numbers count, but also striker Ayase Ueda (foot), whom they do not. Le Mans miss Sidibe and Bourabaa (the numbers take about 16% off their goals for Bourabaa), with Colas and Yohou doubtful. Mathieu Vernice referees, a strict one at 4.5 cards a game, and the numbers already add about 20% to the cards for him; I lean slightly lower on Lille's attack for Ueda and the Bayern game.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals, 1.4 of them for Lille, and they already take off Santos and Le Mans' Bourabaa. Lille will also be without Ueda, a regular scorer the numbers don't list, and may rotate after Bayern on Wednesday; they have scored only 6 in their last six. I lean a little lower, 2.2 to about 2.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners. Both sides win few corners this season (Le Mans about 3.2 a game, Lille 3.9), which is already in their ratings, and rotation could change Lille's shape but nothing points to more or fewer wide attacks, so I stay at about 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.0 cards, already raised about 20% for referee Mathieu Vernice (4.5 a game) and trimmed because Lille draw few cards. Le Mans have been booked often (17 in six), which is counted too, and there is no rivalry, so I stay at 5.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.2 shots and already take some off for Lille's quieter recent run (66 shots in six). A Champions League game against Bayern three days earlier makes rotation likely, and Ueda is out, so I lean slightly lower, 23.2 to about 22.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.2 shots on target, 4.4 of them for Lille. Without Ueda and with tired legs or a changed front line after Bayern, Lille's finishing should be a little blunter than the numbers assume, so I lean slightly lower, 8.2 to about 7.9.
